blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many languages of instruction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are poorly represented in the data used to train language models. Before these models can support early-grade literacy in such languages, we need to know whether they hold the linguistic knowledge of each language that literacy teaching relies on. To test this, we present the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark and the reproducible, largely automated pipeline that turns curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil books into a vetted question set organised on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and seven grade levels. The pipeline combines LLM-driven source survey, feature consolidation, item generation and quality control with an item-selection step inspired by item response theory and a final expert review. We instantiate it for Kiswahili (Kenya; 135 items) and English (United Kingdom; 137 items) and evaluate 121 and 119 models respectively. Frontier models exceed 90% accuracy in both languages, but accuracy falls steeply for smaller and cheaper models, and more so in Kiswahili. The two best models under 10 billion parameters reach 91.7% and 73.0% in English but only 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili, and the mean accuracy of models deployable on mobile and tablet hardware is 47% in English against 24% in Kiswahili. The models most practical for low-resource classrooms are therefore the least capable in the languages they would serve. We release a 20-item sample per language, all pipeline prompts, open-source code, and a public leaderboard. This is the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for measuring and generating decodable text to support foundational literacy.
blocks.zh: 中低收入国家的许多教学语言在用于培训语言模型的数据中代表性不足。 在这些模式能够支持这种语言的早期识字之前,我们需要知道它们是否掌握识字教学所依赖的每一种语言的语言知识。 为了检验这一点,我们提出了语言知识基准和可复制的、基本上自动化的管道,将课程文件、教师指南和学生书籍变成一个经过审查的问题集,由九个语言领域和七个年级组成的固定网格。 管道将LLM驱动源调查,特征整合,项目生成和质量控制与项目响应理论所启发的项目选择步骤和最终专家评审相结合. 我们对斯瓦希里语(肯尼亚;135个项目)和英语(联合王国;137个项目)进行即时评估,并分别评价121个和119个模型。 边疆模型在两种语言中都超过了90%的精度,但是对于更小更便宜的模型来说,精度急剧下降,在斯瓦希里语中尤其如此. 在100亿参数下的两个最佳模型在英语中分别达到91.7%和73.0%,但在斯瓦希里语中只有51.9%和40.7%,在移动和平板硬件上可部署的模型在英语中的平均精度为47%,而在斯瓦希里语中则为24%. 因此,最实用的低资源教室模式在所服务的语文方面最不可行。 我们发布一个20项样本 每种语言,所有管道提示,开源代码, 和一个公共领导板。 这是衡量和生成可解码文本以支持基础扫盲的三级评价梯级的第一组。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Every language is different. In Kiswahili, grammatical number (singular/plural) is often marked through changes to the start of nouns, whereas in English plurals are usually marked with changes to the end of nouns. Pronunciation, word order and tense all vary across languages. How well language models understand and generate text in a language depends in part on how much exposure, and what kind of exposure, they have had to that language.
blocks.zh: 每个语言都是不同的. 在斯瓦希里语中,语法数字(singular/plural)经常通过名词开头的修改来标出,而英语复数中通常会以名词结尾的修改来标出. 发音,词序和时态因语言而异. 语言模型对语言的文字的理解和生成程度,部分取决于其接触的多寡,以及他们接触该语言的种类。

blocks.en: Many languages used in LMICs are poorly represented in AI training data, giving language models fewer opportunities to learn their linguistic structures and patterns. Common Crawl, a public archive of web pages widely used to train AI models, shows this imbalance: African languages account for well below one per cent of its identified content ( Common Crawl, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LMIC使用的许多语言在AI培训数据中代表不足,使得语言模型学习语言结构和模式的机会较少. 常见的Crawl是一个被广泛用于训练AI模型的网页公共档案, 非洲语言占其确定内容的1%以下(Common Crawl, 2026.

blocks.en: If AI is going to help solve the learning crisis, developers and users need to know whether it works in the languages used in LMIC contexts, where mother-tongue instruction is known to have large benefits for foundational literacy ( Alvarez-Marinelli et al., 2025 ) . Much of what teachers need in early-grade literacy is level-specific: practice readers, targeted support and assessment passages, each restricted to the letter–sounds already taught. Such material is called decodable text . Decodable material is scarce in Kiswahili and many other LMIC languages, and AI could help close that gap.
blocks.zh: 如果AI要帮助解决学习危机,开发者和用户需要知道它是否在LMIC背景下所使用的语言中工作,因为据了解,在LMIC环境中,母语教学对基础识字有很大的好处(Alvarez-Marinelli等,2025年)。 教师在早期识字方面需要的大多是程度特殊:实践阅读者、有针对性的支持和评估段落,每个段落都仅限于已经讲授的字母。 这些材料称为可解码文本。 斯瓦希里语和许多其他语言的可解码材料很少,大赦国际可以帮助缩小这一差距。

blocks.en: Our end goal is to evaluate whether AI models can generate decodable text. A single end-to-end score would show whether models succeed, but not why they fail, and therefore not where to intervene. We therefore built a three-rung benchmark ladder that separates the capabilities decodable-text generation depends on. Linguistic Knowledge tests what a model knows about a language’s key features. Decodability Assessment tests whether a model can identify words a child cannot yet decode, given a specified instructional sequence. Decodable Text Generation tests whether a model can write text that is decodable. This paper concerns the first rung.
blocks.zh: 我们的最终目标是评价AI模型是否能够生成可解码文本. 单一的端到端得分会显示模型是否成功,但不会显示其失败的原因,因此不会显示在哪里干预. 因此,我们建立了一个三重基准梯子,将可编解码文本生成能力分开。 语言知识测试一个模型对语言关键特征的了解。 解码性评估测试一个模型是否能够识别一个孩子尚不能解码的词,给出了特定的指令序列. 可解码的文本生成测试一个模型是否能够写入可解码的文本. 本文涉及第一个问题。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • A reproducible, language-agnostic pipeline that turns linguistic knowledge gathered from primary sources into a vetted evaluation benchmark, with automated stages for source survey, consolidation, item generation and quality control, an item-selection step inspired by item response theory, and a final expert review (Section 2 ). • Two instantiations of the pipeline: a Kiswahili benchmark built from Kenya-focused resources (135 items) and an English benchmark built from UK-focused resources (137 items), each validated at the item-selection, expert-review and scoring levels. • An evaluation of 121 models in Kiswahili and 119 in English, showing that frontier models perform very well in both languages while the smaller models that are more practical for on-device and resource-constrained deployment struggle, with a consistently larger deficit in Kiswahili (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献如下:一个可复制的、语言不可知的管道,把从主要来源收集的语言知识变成一个经过审查的评价基准,其中自动分几个阶段进行源头调查、合并、项目生成和质量控制,项目选择步骤受项目响应理论的启发,以及最后的专家审查(第2节)。 管道的两个瞬间:一个由肯尼亚重点资源(135项)所建立的一个斯瓦希里基准和由联合王国重点资源(137项)所建立的一个英文基准,每个基准在项目选择、专家审查和评分各级得到验证。 对121个斯瓦希里语模型和119个英语模型的评价显示,前沿模型在两种语言中都表现良好,而较小的模型则更为实用,更适合进行安装和资源受限制的部署斗争,而斯瓦希里语的赤字一直较大(第3节)。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.1 管道

blocks.en: We designed the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark as a reproducible pipeline so that it can be adapted and produced for additional languages. The pipeline turns source documents (curricula, reference grammars, teacher guides and pupil books) into a vetted question set that assesses how well a model can answer questions about language features relevant to foundational literacy. Every question sits on a fixed grid of nine linguistic domains and school grade levels (from pre-primary to Grade 5 and beyond) that stays the same across languages (Table A1 ). The grade tag records where the content is first introduced in the curriculum, not how hard the question is. Each item also carries two framework tags: the strand of the Simple View of Reading (SVR; Gough and Tunmer, 1986 ) that the tested knowledge serves (decoding or language comprehension), and the core instructional component identified by the Global Education Evidence Advisory Panel (GEEAP; Alvarez-Marinelli et al., 2025 ) that an error in the item would corrupt (Table A5 ). The methodology and linguistic domains were reviewed with sector pedagogy experts.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了 " 语言知识基准 " ,作为可复制的管道,以便加以修改和制作,用于其他语文。 管道将原始文件(课程、参考语法、教师指南和学生书籍)变成一套经过审查的问题集,评估一个模型是否能够很好地回答有关基础识字语言特征的问题。 每个问题都包含9个语言领域和年级(从学前到五年级及以后),各语言之间保持不变(表A1)。 分级标记记录内容最早被引入课程的地方,而不是问题有多难. 每个项目还带有两个框架标记:所测试的知识所服务的阅读简易视图(SVR;Gough和Tunmer,1986年)的线条(解码或语言理解),以及全球教育证据咨询小组(GEEAP;Alvarez-Marinelli等,2025年)确定的项目出错会腐败的核心教学部分(表A5)。 与部门教育学专家审查了方法和语言领域。

blocks.en: Importantly, the benchmark targets formal linguistic competence (getting the form of a language right) rather than functional competence (using the language to accomplish goals in the world), the two being distinct cognitive skills ( Mahowald et al., 2024 ) . The two upper rungs, Decodability Assessment and Decodable Text Generation, test functional competence and are currently under development.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,基准针对的是正式语言能力(获得语言正确形式),而不是职能能力(利用语言实现世界的目标),两者是不同的认知技能(Mahowald等,2024年)。 上行的两个上行,即可解码性评估和可解码文本生成,测试功能能力,目前正在开发中.

blocks.en: 2.2 Design rationale
blocks.zh: 2.2 设计理由

blocks.en: The pipeline was built following three guiding principles. • Mirror the expert workflow. The pipeline keeps the main stages of benchmark construction separate: reviewing the source documents, inventorying testable facts, consolidating them into a unified map of the language, drafting questions against that map, quality-checking them, and selecting a balanced final set. Keeping each stage separate creates a traceable process, making it easier for experts to identify where quality degrades. • Use experts selectively. The pipeline automates source-document analysis, extraction, question drafting and initial quality control, and uses domain experts for the final review. This reduces the amount of expert time required per benchmark while retaining human judgement. • Reuse across languages. Every stage uses a language-agnostic prompt, so adapting the benchmark to a new language only requires swapping the source documents and revising the language-specific content of the prompts (Table A2 ).

blocks.en: 2.3 Orchestration
blocks.zh: 2.3 管弦

blocks.en: The benchmark development team inputs a curated set of resources (typically 6 to 11) covering the standard early-literacy topics in the target language: curriculum documents, teacher guides and pupil-facing books. The resources used for each language are listed in Tables A6 and A7 . The pipeline classifies each source into one of four tiers: curriculum, teacher material, student material, and other (e.g. a grammar book). Figure 1 summarises the end-to-end process. The pipeline then proceeds as follows.
blocks.zh: 基准发展小组投入了一整套资源(通常为6至11个),涵盖目标语言的标准早期扫盲专题:课程文件、教师指南和学生读物。 每种语言所使用的资源见表A6和A7。 管道将每个来源分为四个层次之一:课程,教师材料,学生材料等(如文法书). 图1总结了端到端过程. 输油管随后进行如下。

blocks.en: 1. Survey the resources (Prompt A1 ). One document at a time, the pipeline compiles a list of linguistic facts. For each fact it records a verbatim example, a document location (file, page, heading), the domain, and the grade at which the content is first introduced. Working per document means sources can be processed in parallel or added later. 2. Merge the extracted facts (Prompt A2 ). All facts are consolidated into a single feature map, grouped by domain and ordered by grade. Duplicates are merged into one feature listing all of its contributing sources. Where two sources disagree on a grade, the highest-tier source wins, according to a manual hierarchy given in the prompt. 3. Generate question items (Prompt A3 ). Items are either multiple choice or short answer, depending on the nature of the fact: contrasts and judgements are tested through multiple-choice items, while facts about producing a form use short-answer items. Using both formats lets us test unaided recall as well as the ability to distinguish correct forms from plausible, diagnostic errors. This stage is run once per subset of sources small enough to fit in the context window. It deliberately oversamples, generating several candidates per feature and making no global decisions about counts or balance. 4. Quality-check the items (Prompt A4 ). All candidates are pooled and each is checked against explicit anti-gaming and shape rules. For instance, the answer must not be given away in the stem, options must be length-parallel and functionally plausible, and the item must not be solvable by general reasoning alone. Duplicates are grouped and ranked rather than deleted, so nothing is discarded without a record. 5. Compile a working dataset. Items are selected using an approach inspired by item response theory (IRT; Lord, 1980 ), a statistical framework for judging how well each question separates stronger from weaker performers. Using the responses of a panel of 10 models spanning different providers and a wide performance range (Table A3 ), we select a trimmed set that (a) avoids saturation by dropping items every model gets right, (b) maximises differentiation by favouring high-discrimination items, and (c) keeps a balanced domain × \times grade spread. Items that no model answers correctly are deliberately kept and flagged for the human expert to review.

blocks.zh: 质量检查项目(Prompt A4 .). 所有候选人都是集合的,每个候选人都要遵守明确的反竞争和定型规则。 例如,不能在干线中给出答案,选择必须是长相平行的,在功能上是可信的,项目不能仅凭一般推理而解决。 复制品被分组并排行,而不是被删除,因此没有记录,任何内容都会被丢弃.

blocks.en: Compile a working dataset. Items are selected using an approach inspired by item response theory (IRT; Lord, 1980 ), a statistical framework for judging how well each question separates stronger from weaker performers. Using the responses of a panel of 10 models spanning different providers and a wide performance range (Table A3 ), we select a trimmed set that (a) avoids saturation by dropping items every model gets right, (b) maximises differentiation by favouring high-discrimination items, and (c) keeps a balanced domain × \times grade spread. Items that no model answers correctly are deliberately kept and flagged for the human expert to review.
blocks.zh: 汇编工作数据集。 选择项目时采用的是项目响应理论(IRT;Lord,1980年)所启发的方法,这是判断每个问题与表现较弱者之间有多大区别的统计框架. 我们利用一个包括不同供应商和广泛性能范围的由10个模型组成的小组(表A3)的反应,选择了一套经过调整的组合,以便(a) 通过丢弃每个模型得到的正确项目来避免饱和,(b) 通过偏好高差别项目来最大程度的区分,(c) 保持一个平衡的域x\\分级分布。 没有正确答案的项目被刻意保存并标出,供人类专家审查。

blocks.en: A linguist or first-language speaker then reviews every question, adapting or discarding any items with remaining issues to create the final benchmark dataset. The automated process tracks sources throughout, which keeps the build verifiable, focuses human expertise on quality review, and keeps the overall process less costly. After the final human review, we check that the correct answers to multiple-choice items are evenly distributed across the four options, so that position is not a usable cue.
blocks.zh: 然后,语言学家或第一语言演讲者审查每个问题,修改或丢弃任何有剩余问题的项目,以建立最后基准数据集。 自动流程跟踪各种来源,使构建过程可以核查,将人的专门知识集中在质量审查上,并使整个流程的成本降低。 在最后的人类审查之后,我们检查对多选择物品的正确答案是否在四个选项中均匀分布,因此这个位置不是一个可用的提示.

blocks.en: Every item asks about the target language but is written in English. This keeps what we are measuring separate from what we are not: asking about a language’s structure in that language confounds linguistic knowledge with reading comprehension and instruction-following in the same language, so a wrong answer is hard to attribute. Posing questions in English isolates whether the model knows the formal properties of the target language, and matches some real deployments, where a tool may be operated in English while producing local-language content. This is a favourable setting, so results should be read as an upper bound (Section 4 ). It also leaves open the option of translating the items later. Table 1 shows two items from the public Kiswahili sample, one in each answer format.
blocks.zh: 每个项目都询问目标语言,但都用英语写出。 这样,我们所衡量的与我们所没有的区别:询问一种语言在那种语言中的结构将语言知识与同一种语言的阅读理解和教学混淆起来,因此一个错误的答案很难归属。 用英语投出的问题孤立了模型是否知道目标语言的形式属性,并匹配一些真实的部署,其中一个工具在制作本地语言内容时可以使用英语来操作. 这是一个有利的环境,因此结果应被理解为上限(第4节)。 这也留下了日后翻译这些项目的选择。 表1显示公众斯瓦希里抽样的两个项目,每个答案格式各一个。

blocks.en: Table 1: Two items from the public Kiswahili sample. Both are written in English and ask about Kiswahili. The grade is where the content is first introduced in the Kenyan curriculum, not the difficulty of the item.
blocks.zh: 表1:公众斯瓦希里语样本中的两件物品. 两者都用英文写成并询问斯瓦希里语的情况. 该分是内容最早被引入肯尼亚课程的地方,而不是项目的难度.

blocks.zh: 所有提示均载于附录A。 该代码在 GitHub 1 1 1 上是开源 https://github.com/Fab-Inc/qa-benchmarks-monorepo 上作为软件包,可以通过多个提供者的API运行.

blocks.zh: 图1:以目标语言编制语言知识基准的端到端管道。 绿色表示由基准团队或语言学家完成的步骤;蓝色表示自动化步骤.

blocks.en: 2.4 Pipeline validation
blocks.zh: 2.4 管道验证

blocks.en: We validated the pipeline at two levels: the effect of item selection and the outcome of expert review.
blocks.zh: 我们在两个层面验证了管道:项目选择的效果和专家审查的结果。

blocks.en: For Kiswahili, item selection reduces the pool from 307 to 150 items, meeting the target of 150 set in the selection code. Of the 157 items removed, 85 were answered correctly by all ten models and therefore carry no discriminating power. The remainder were trimmed on difficulty, discrimination, and spread across linguistic domains and grade levels. For English, the same procedure reduces 377 items to 140, marginally below target, as 217 items were answered correctly by every model. Figure 2 reports domain × \times grade coverage for Kiswahili before and after selection, together with the proportion of items dropped within each domain and each grade.
blocks.zh: 对于斯瓦希里语,项目选择将池从307个项目减少到150个,达到了选择代码中设定的150个目标. 在删除的157件物品中,85件得到了所有10个模型的正确答复,因此没有歧视性权力。 其余部分是针对困难、歧视、以及语言领域和级别进行的。 就英文而言,同一程序将377项减少到140项,略低于目标,因为每个模式都正确回答了217项。 图2报告了在选择前后斯瓦希里语的分级覆盖率,以及每个分级和每个分级内项目下降的比例。

blocks.en: The reduction is broadly uniform: most domains and grades lose between 40% and 60% of their items, so no single stratum absorbs a disproportionate share of the cut. Two strata depart from this pattern, both of which were sparsely populated in the full bank: D7 (Pragmatics and Discourse), which loses 80% of its items, and Grade 0, which is dropped in full and is therefore not represented in the released set. All remaining domains and grades retain coverage. The corresponding figure for English is given in Figure A1 . In both languages, model ranking by accuracy is unchanged between the full pool and the selected set (Spearman ρ = 1.00 \rho=1.00 , Kendall τ = 1.00 \tau=1.00 ), indicating that the selected set induces the same ordering over models as the full pool. Table A4 reports the selection counts and both validation diagnostics for each language. To check that the selected set does not depend on the particular composition of the panel, we also re-ran the selection once for every pair of panel models left out (45 runs) and recorded, for each item in the selected set, the share of runs in which it was selected again. The mean of this selection frequency is 0.90 for English and 0.89 for Kiswahili, so the selected items are largely stable under changes to the panel.
blocks.zh: 减幅大致一致:大多数域和分级损失了40%至60%的项目,因此没有单一的分层吸收了削减中不成比例的份额. 有两个阶层背离了这种模式,这两个阶层在全库中人口稀少:D7级(Pracmatics and Distression),损失了80%的物品;而0级则全数下降,因此没有在发行的套集中得到体现. 其余所有领域和职等都保留了覆盖面。 英语的相应数字见图A1。 在两种语言中,以精度排列的模型在全池和所选集之间没有变化(Spearman ^ 1.00\rho=1.00,Kendall → 1.00\tau=1.00),表明所选集在模型上诱导的顺序与全池相同. 表A4报告了每种语言的选择计数和两种验证诊断。 为了检查所选的集不取决于面板的特定组成,我们还重新对每对被丢出(45跑)的面板模型进行一次选择,并记录了所选集中每个项目的运行份额。 这种选取频率的平均值为:英语为0.90,斯瓦希里语为0.89,因此选取的项目在面板改变后基本稳定.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Kiswahili item coverage across linguistic domains (D1–D9) and grade levels (G0–G5, BP = beyond primary) before and after item selection. See Figure A1 for English.
blocks.zh: 图2 斯瓦希里语项目在项目选择前后覆盖语言领域(D1-D9)和级别(G0-G5,BP=超过初级). 英文见图A1。

blocks.en: Every candidate item passing the selection step was read by a human expert before entering the final set. Reviewers worked from a fixed rubric separating two judgements per item: whether the item itself is sound (accept as is, edit, or reject when the flaw was too large to repair), and, independently, whether its metadata is correct (domain, grade, SVR strand, GEEAP component; Table A5 ). Kiswahili was reviewed twice, sequentially. A pedagogy expert reviewed all 150 candidates, dropping 12 and correcting 9. The resulting 138 items then went to an early-literacy expert and native Kiswahili speaker, who dropped a further 3 and edited 10, yielding the final 135. English was reviewed once, by a pedagogy expert and native English speaker, over 140 candidates: 3 were dropped and 7 rewritten, yielding the final 137.
blocks.zh: 每个通过选拔步骤的候选项目,在进入最后一组之前,都由一个人类专家阅读. 审查者从一个固定标题中工作,将每个项目分出两个判断:项目本身是否合理(接受、编辑,或当缺陷太大无法修复时拒绝),以及独立的元数据是否正确(领域、级别、SVR线条、GEEAP组件;表A5)。 斯瓦希里语经过了两次连续的审查。 一名教育学专家审查了所有150名候选人,减少了12名,并改正了9. 由此产生的138个项目随后交给了一名早期识字专家和斯瓦希里母语者,他们又掉了3名,编辑了10名,最后135名。 一名教育学专家和英语母语者对英语进行了一次审查,有140多位候选人:3人被放弃,7人被改写,最终获得137人。

blocks.en: Taken together, the experts’ decisions to edit or drop items followed recurring patterns. Rejections traced to problems with how the items were generated, and the same problems came up in both languages. Redundancy dominated in Kiswahili, where most first-pass drops duplicated a linguistic feature covered elsewhere; answer leakage (the target answer recoverable from the stem) accounted for a smaller share. The remainder in both languages were items with more than one defensible answer, and items that measured the wrong thing (testing linguistics expertise rather than teacher knowledge, or covering content not taught in schools). Edits diverged by language. English corrections were almost entirely to metadata, most often reassigning an SVR strand or GEEAP component. Kiswahili second-pass edits mainly expanded an item’s set of accepted answers ( expected_answers , Table A5 ) with valid responses the generation stage had missed.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,专家们关于编辑或删除项目的决定遵循了反复出现的模式。 拒绝的原因有:项目是如何产生的;两种语言都出现了同样的问题。 在斯瓦希里语中,冗余现象占主导地位,大多数第一通道的下降与其他地方所覆盖的语言特征相重复;答漏(目标答案可以从源头收回)所占份额较小。 其余的两种语言都是有不止一种合理答案的项目,以及衡量错误的项目(测试语言学专门知识而不是教师知识,或涵盖学校未教授的内容)。 编辑因语言而异。 英语的校正几乎完全针对元数据,最经常的是重新分配SVR线程或GEEAP组件. 斯瓦希里二通编辑主要扩充了一组被接受的答案(期望答案,表A5),

blocks.en: 2.5 Scoring
blocks.zh: 2.5 分数

blocks.en: We use regular-expression parsing for multiple-choice items and LLM-as-a-judge for short-answer items. The prompts used for question answering and judging are reproduced in Prompts A5 and A6 .
blocks.zh: 我们使用常规的表达解析 用于多选择项目 和LLM -as -a法官 用于短答项目。 用于回答和判断问题的提示转载于Expones A5和A6。

blocks.en: For short answers, we run three judges, one each from three different providers, and take the majority verdict, to avoid the bias and prompt-sensitivity of any single judge ( Verga et al., 2024 ) : Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), GPT-5.6 Terra (OpenAI) and Gemini-3.6 Flash (Google). The judge prompt is strict: it accepts only differences of capitalisation, hyphenation and spacing, never synonyms or paraphrases (Prompt A6 ). Chain-of-thought blocks from a model’s reasoning are stripped from the text sent to the judge, so that a long reasoning trace cannot dwarf the actual answer.
blocks.zh: 对于简短的回答,我们运行三名法官,三名不同的法官各一名,并作出多数判决,以避免任何一名法官的偏见和迅速敏感性(Verga等人,2024年): Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic),GPT-5.6 Terra (OpenAI)和双子座-3.6 Flash (Google). 法官提示很严格:它只接受大写,连字符和相距的区别,从来不是同义词或同义词(Prompt A6 . 模型推理的思维链块被从发给法官的文字中剥去,这样长的推理痕迹不能使实际答案相形见绌.

blocks.en: Each judge replies in a structured format with two fields: a boolean verdict and a written justification. The verdict is used directly to compute accuracy, while the justification serves two purposes. It requires the judge to ground its verdict in verifiable facts, and it makes it possible to inspect a judge’s reasoning and disagreements between judges. For example, during development we noticed that some short-answer items were missing valid answers from their expected_answers list (Table A5 ), because many models consistently answered with a valid synonym that was not listed.
blocks.zh: 每位法官以结构化的形式回答,分为两个领域:布尔判决和书面理由。 判决直接用来计算准确性,而理由有两个目的。 它要求法官以可核实的事实作为判决的依据,并且能够检查法官的推理和法官之间的分歧。 例如,在开发过程中,我们注意到一些短答项目在其预期的_答案列表(表A5)中缺少有效的答案,因为许多模型始终用一个没有列出的有效同义词回答.

blocks.en: For multiple choice, six regular-expression patterns cover the common response formats, including answers wrapped in parentheses and answers that follow a closed reasoning block. When a model’s response matches none of the patterns, we run a fallback pass that sends only those unparseable rows to a single LLM judge, asking whether the response indicates the correct letter (Prompt A6 ). Any multiple-choice answer that cannot be parsed is either resolved by the fallback judge or excluded from the accuracy denominator; it is never counted as wrong. Each scored row records which method produced its verdict ( regex , llm_judge , llm_fallback or unscored ), so that strict-format scores remain distinguishable from rescued ones. We report accuracy for each model computed over scored rows only, with the unscored count reported alongside.
blocks.zh: 对于多选择,有6个正则表达模式覆盖了常见的响应格式,包括用括号包裹的答案和遵循闭合推理块的答案. 当一个模型的响应与所有模式都不相匹配时,我们运行一个倒置通关,只向一个LLM法官发送那些无法解开的行,询问响应是否表示正确的字母(Prompt A6). 任何无法解析的多选择答案要么由倒计时法官解决,要么被排除在准确分母之外;它从未被算作错误. 每个得分的行记录,哪个方法得出了它的判决(regex,llm_judge,llm_fallback或未得分),因此严格格式的得分仍然与被拯救的得分相区别. 我们只报告每个模型的准确性,没有记分的计数报告在旁边。

blocks.en: 2.6 Scoring validation
blocks.zh: 2.6 分数验证

blocks.en: The scoring layer was validated alongside the items, with each check summarised below.
blocks.zh: 计分层与项目一起进行了验证,每个检查摘要如下。

blocks.en: Agreement between the three LLM judges on short-answer responses is reported as the raw pairwise rate and as Cohen’s κ \kappa , which corrects for the inflation that raw agreement exhibits when most responses are correct. Pairwise agreement was higher in Kiswahili (97.5–98.7%, κ \kappa 0.944–0.970) than in English (92.8–96.4%, κ \kappa 0.773–0.897), with full three-way consensus on 97.0% of judged short-answer responses in Kiswahili and 92.1% in English. The remainder were 2-of-3 splits resolved by majority vote.
blocks.zh: 三位LLM法官就短答问题达成协议, 斯瓦希里语的对等协议(97.5–98.7%,0.944–0.970)高于英语(92.8–96.4%,0.773–0.897),对斯瓦希里语的97.0%的评断短答和92.1%的英语的评断短答完全三相一致. 其余的3分之2以多数票解决。

blocks.en: LLM judges can favour their own outputs ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ) , so we checked whether any judge favoured responses from models of its own provider. We compared each judge’s leniency toward responses from its own provider with its leniency toward other providers’ responses, where leniency denotes marking an item correct that the other two judges mark incorrect (rows where the other two disagree are excluded). We found no meaningful self-preference effect on scoring in either language.
blocks.zh: LLM法官可以偏向自己的产出(Panicksery等,2024年),因此我们检查是否有任何法官喜欢自己供应商的模型做出回应. 我们比较了每位法官对其本身提供方答复的宽大处理与对其他提供方答复的宽大处理,因为宽大处理意味着一个项目是正确的,即其他两名法官标记不正确(其他两名法官的不同意见被排除)。 我们没有发现任何一种语言的自喜效果。

blocks.en: A single LLM judge (Claude Sonnet 5) re-scored multiple-choice rows where parsing failed, using Prompt A6 . Fallback was never invoked for 90% of models in English and 91% in Kiswahili. Among models that required it, the higher-scoring models showed either an increase in accuracy or no change. Claude Sonnet 4.5 went from 92.2% (95/103) to 94.2% (129/137) in English, and from 78.2% (79/101) to 81.5% (110/135) in Kiswahili; Kimi K2.5 went from 97.0% (127/131) to 97.1% (133/137) in English. Their recovered answers were correct about as often as the answers that parsed normally. The smallest models did not gain, and some lost accuracy: Qwen3-1.7B went from 53.6% (52/97) to 48.9% (67/137) in English, and Llama-3.2-1B from 27.3% (36/132) to 27.0% (37/137). Their recovered answers were mostly wrong.
blocks.zh: 一名LLM裁判(Claude Sonnet 5)重新评分多选择行, 在英语中90%的模型和斯瓦希里语中91%的模型从未被引用回落. 在需要这种技术的模型中,得分较高的模型显示精度提高或没有变化。 Claude Sonnet 4.5在英语中从92.2%(95/103)到94.2%(129/137),在斯瓦希里语中从78.2%(79/101)到81.5%(110/135);Kimi K2.5在英语中从97.0%(127/131)到97.1%(133/137). 他们寻回的答案与正常解析的答案一样经常是正确的。 最小的模型没有获得,一些丧失了准确性: Qune3-1.7B 英语从53.6%(52/97)升至48.9%(67/137),Llama-3.2-1B从27.3%(36/132)升至27.0%(37/137)。 他们找到的答案大多是错误的。

blocks.en: We checked consistency across six model families (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen) in both languages. Accuracy respects model size and tier overall, with only isolated inversions among same-generation, same-tier variants (e.g. within GPT and Qwen). This is consistent with the benchmark measuring a capability that scales with model size (Figures A2 and A3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们检查了六个模范家庭(克洛德、GPT、双子座、Gemma、Llama、Quen)在两种语言中的一致性。 精确度在整体上尊重模型大小和分级,同代,同级变体中只有孤立的倒置(如GPT和Quen内部). 这与衡量以模型大小为尺度的能力的基准一致(图A2和A3)。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: Accuracy spans nearly the full available range in both languages, from 99% for the highest-scoring model to 10% for the lowest. Frontier models cluster above 90%, while accuracy declines steeply among mid-sized and smaller models (Figures 4 and 4 ).
blocks.zh: 准确度几乎跨越两种语言的全部可用范围,从最高评分模式的99%到最低模式的10%。 前沿模型集群超过90%,而中小型模型的准确性则急剧下降(图4和图4)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Accuracy on the English Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark ( n = 137 n=137 items) for the 49 models pre-selected for the public leaderboard (of 119 evaluated). Accuracy is computed over scored rows only. Error bars show 95% confidence intervals from 1,000 bootstrap replicates resampling items with replacement.
blocks.zh: 图3:为公共领导板预选的49个模型(119个被评为),英语语言知识基准上的精确度(n=137n=137个项目). 准确性仅通过得分行计算。 出错栏显示1000个靴子的95%的置信间隔复制被替换的项目.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Accuracy on the Kiswahili Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark ( n = 135 n=135 items) for the 49 models pre-selected for the public leaderboard (of 121 evaluated). Accuracy is computed over scored rows only. Error bars show 95% confidence intervals from 1,000 bootstrap replicates resampling items with replacement.
blocks.zh: 图4 斯瓦希里语语言知识基准的准确性(n=135n=135项),为公共领导板预选的49个模型(121个被评价). 准确性仅通过得分行计算。 出错栏显示1000个靴子的95%的置信间隔复制被替换的项目.

blocks.en: The two languages are not equivalent. English exhibits a longer plateau above 90% and a shallower tail, whereas the Kiswahili distribution begins to fall away earlier and extends lower (Figure 4 ). Consequently, the set of models meeting any given accuracy threshold is substantially smaller in Kiswahili than in English. Figures 4 and 4 show the subset of models pre-selected for the public leaderboard; accuracies for all evaluated models are reported in Tables A8 and A9 .
blocks.zh: 两种语言不相等同. 英文显示高地在90%以上,尾巴更浅;而斯瓦希里语的分布开始提前下降并延伸更低(图4)。 因此,在斯瓦希里语中,达到任何精确阈值的一套模型比在英语中要小得多。 图4和图4显示预选的公共领导板模型的子集;表A8和A9报告所有评价模型的精度。

blocks.en: These results have a direct consequence for deployment. The models that perform strongly on the benchmark are the largest and most costly to serve, whereas the affordable, offline-capable models (those that could plausibly operate in a low-resource classroom) are the least able to hold the linguistic knowledge a foundational-literacy application would depend on. At or below $0.10 per million tokens (assuming a 3:1 ratio of input to output tokens), the best model available at the time of writing is Qwen3.7 Flash, which reaches 96.4% in English but 69.6% in Kiswahili. Among models small enough to run on a phone or tablet (below 10 billion parameters), the two best are Qwen3.5 9B and Gemma-4 E2B, at 91.7% and 73.0% in English but 51.9% and 40.7% in Kiswahili. Strong performance is therefore achievable, but not at the price point or under the operating constraints that make such tools practical to deploy, and the gap for smaller models is larger in Kiswahili than in English (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 这些结果对部署有直接影响。 在基准上表现强劲的模型是服务的最大和成本最高的,而廉价的离线能力模型(那些在资源低的教室里可以合理运行的模型)最不能掌握基本识字应用所依赖的语言知识。 在撰写报告时,每百万个信使有0.1美元或以下(假定输入值与产出信使有3:1的比例),最佳模式是Qune3.7。 Flash,英语达到96.4%,而斯瓦希里语达到69.6%. 在小到可以跑到电话或平板电脑上的模型(低于100亿参数)中,两种最好的是Qune3.5 9B和Gemma-4 E2B,英语为91.7%和73.0%,而斯瓦希里语为51.9%和40.7%。 因此,强劲的性能是可以实现的,但在价格点或操作限制下无法使这种工具能够实际部署,而斯瓦希里语中较小的型号的差距大于英语(图5).

Both x-axes are logarithmic. The dashed step line traces the Pareto frontier, i.e. the highest accuracy attainable at or below each cost or size.

blocks.en: We grouped models by hardware tier so that accuracy could be compared across the classes of device available in LMIC classrooms, where memory and connectivity determine which models can be run locally. Each model is assigned the smallest tier on which it could run as the primary foreground workload. Closed-weight models are placed in the cloud tier first, since their weights cannot be obtained at any size. The remainder are assigned on total parameter count against a per-tier memory budget, defined as the device’s total RAM multiplied by the share a model can claim, at the precision assumed for that tier (4-bit on mobile and tablet, 8-bit at workstation class). The full methodology, assumptions and caveats are given in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们按硬件级别对模型进行了分类,以便可以比较LMIC教室现有设备的准确性,在这类设备中,内存和连通性决定了哪些模型可以在当地运行。 每个模型被分配到最小的一级,作为主要前景工作量。 闭重模型先被放入云层中,因为其重量无法以任何大小获得. 其余是按每层内存预算的总参数计数分配的,定义是设备的总内存乘以一个模型可以要求的股份,精确地假定为该层(移动平板电脑上4位,工作站班上8位)。 完整的方法、假设和说明载于附录D。

blocks.en: Accuracy declines monotonically as the memory budget decreases, in both languages (Figure 6 ). Mean accuracy in the cloud tier is 91% for English and 79% for Kiswahili, falling to 61% and 41% at workstation class and to 47% and 24% on mobile and tablet hardware. The Kiswahili deficit persists at every tier and widens steadily as hardware shrinks, from 12 percentage points in the cloud tier to 20 at workstation class and 23 on mobile and tablet. The models most likely to be deployed in a low-resource classroom are thus the least capable in the language they would be deployed to serve. The workstation tier rests on 4 models and the mobile and tablet tier on 11, however, so their means should be read as indicative.
blocks.zh: 在两种语言中,由于内存预算减少,准确性单调下降(图6)。 云层的平均精度为:英语为91%,斯瓦希里语为79%,工作站班的精度为61%和41%,移动和平板硬件为47%和24%。 随着硬件的收缩,斯瓦希里语的赤字在每一层都持续存在并稳步扩大,从云层的12个百分点下降到工作站班的20个百分点和移动平板电脑的23个百分点。 因此,最有可能部署在资源匮乏的教室中的模型在将部署使用的语言方面能力最差。 然而,工作站的等级是4个模型,11个是移动式和平板式,因此其手段应被理解为指示性的。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Benchmark accuracy by deployment hardware tier and language. Models are grouped by the smallest class of device on which they could run locally, estimated from total parameter count; mobile and tablet are reported together. Accuracy was measured at each model’s best available precision (16-bit in almost all cases), whereas the tiers assume 4-bit quantisation on mobile and tablet and 8-bit at workstation class, so on-device accuracy would be below the values plotted here. Each marker is the tier’s mean accuracy, with error bars giving a 95% confidence interval from 1,000 bootstrap resamples over models; n n is the number of models in each tier.

blocks.en: We did not run a formal human baseline, but our discussions with experts suggest that a trained Kiswahili lower-primary teacher would score roughly 80–90% on these items. Relatedly, coverage across the nine linguistic domains and grade levels is intended to ensure the benchmark spans the curriculum, not to support performance claims within any individual domain or grade. Cell counts are small and unevenly distributed, so we do not interpret per-cell accuracies.
blocks.zh: 我们没有运行一个正式的人类基线,但我们与专家的讨论表明,受过训练的斯瓦希里低等教师在这些方面将获得大约80-90%的分数。 与此相关的是,涵盖9个语言领域和年级的目的是确保基准跨越课程范围,而不是支持任何单个领域或年级的绩效要求。 细胞计数小而分布不均,因此我们不解释每个细胞的精度.

blocks.en: 4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4 限制

blocks.en: We identify three limitations of the present study, concerning the medium of the items, the scope of the construct, and the inference conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们确定了本研究的三个局限性,涉及物品的介质、构造范围和推断条件。

blocks.en: Questions are written in English and ask about the target language, which isolates linguistic knowledge from reading comprehension and instruction-following in the same language. Asking about a language in English is an easier task than operating in it, so this construction is likely to overstate what a model would achieve on the same content presented in the target language, and the near-ceiling scores we observe for frontier models may partly reflect the English medium. Results should be read as an upper bound. A version with items written in the target language would plausibly lower scores across the board, and the option of translating items programmatically remains open.
blocks.zh: 问题用英语写出,并询问目标语言,它将语言知识与同一种语言的阅读理解和教学相隔离. 询问英文语言比在其中操作容易,因此这种构造可能过高描述一个模型在目标语言中呈现的相同内容上会实现什么,我们为前沿模型观察到的接近上限的分数可能会部分地反映英语介质. 结果应读作上限. 用目标语言编写项目的版本将合理降低总体得分,在方案上翻译项目的选项仍然开放。

blocks.en: The benchmark is a retrieval test by design: it establishes whether a model holds a linguistic fact, not whether it can apply that fact in the situations a classroom tool would demand. This motivates its position as the first of three benchmarks in our suite: Linguistic Knowledge, Decodability Assessment, and Decodable Text Generation. The latter two test whether models can put that knowledge to work, by identifying words a learner cannot yet decode and by writing text within a given instructional sequence. A model can pass this benchmark while failing either. Retrieval is a necessary condition for decodable-text generation, not a sufficient one, and the near-ceiling frontier scores reported here should not be read as evidence that the end goal is met.
blocks.zh: 基准是按设计进行的检索测试:它确定一个模型是否有语言事实,而不是它是否能够在课堂工具需要的情况下应用这一事实。 这激发了它作为我们套间三个基准中的第一项:语言知识、可解码性评估和可解码文本生成。 后两个测试模型是否能够使这种知识发挥作用,方法是确定一个学习者尚不能解码的词和在特定的教学序列中写出文字。 一个模型可以在失败时通过这个基准。 检索是可解码文本生成的一个必要条件,不足够,本文所报道的接近上限的前沿分数不应被解读为达到最终目标的证据.

blocks.en: All models are run under a single fixed configuration, and we did not explore the decoding and reasoning parameters that would plausibly change the ranking. Sampling settings such as temperature and other decoding controls were left at their defaults, which is likely to matter most for the smaller models, where answer stability is more sensitive to configuration. We inspected outputs to confirm that low scores were not artefacts of parsing or answer-extraction failure, so the gap we report is not a formatting artefact, but we cannot rule out that different decoding settings would raise smaller-model accuracy. Similarly, we did not vary reasoning effort or extended-thinking budgets for the larger models that support them, so their reported accuracy reflects one operating point rather than the frontier of what they can achieve. The reported figures should therefore be read as accuracy under one specific configuration, not as an upper bound on model capability.
blocks.zh: 所有的模型都是在一个单一的固定配置下运行的,我们没有探索解码和推理参数,这些参数可以合理地改变排名. 模拟设置,如温度和其他解码控制在它们的默认值上被留了下来,这对较小的模型来说可能最为重要,因为答案稳定性对配置更为敏感. 我们检查了产出,以证实低分数不是解析或解答失败的工艺品,因此我们报告的差距不是一个格式化的活字,但我们不能排除不同的解码设置会提高较小的模型精度。 同样,我们也没有对支持这些模型的较大模型的推理努力或扩展思考预算作出不同调整,因此,它们报告的准确性反映了一个操作点,而不是它们能够实现的前沿。 因此,应将所报告的数字理解为一个具体配置的准确性,而不是模型能力的上限。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced the Linguistic Knowledge Benchmark, the first rung of a three-level evaluation ladder for decodable-text generation, and a reproducible pipeline that builds such a benchmark from a language’s own curriculum and teaching materials with expert effort concentrated on the final review. Applied to Kiswahili and English, the benchmark separates models across nearly the full accuracy range. Frontier models answer almost all items correctly in both languages, but the cheaper and smaller models that could realistically run in low-resource classrooms lose much more ground in Kiswahili than in English, and this gap widens as hardware shrinks. For developers, the practical implication is that model choice for LMIC literacy tools cannot be made from English results alone. For the field, the results show where intervention is needed: smaller, deployable models need better coverage of the languages they would serve.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了《语言知识基准》,这是可解码文本生成的三级评价阶梯的起步部分,也是从语文本身的课程和教材中建立这样一个基准的可复制的管道,专家的努力集中于最后审查。 基准适用于斯瓦希里语和英语,将模型分离到几乎全部准确范围。 边疆模型在两种语言中几乎都正确回答了所有项目,但可以现实地在低资源课堂上运行的更便宜更小的模型在斯瓦希里语中损失了比英语多得多的地盘,随着硬件收缩,这一差距会扩大. 对开发者来说,其实际含义是,单凭英语结果无法对LMIC识字工具进行模型选择. 就外地而言,结果显示需要干预的地方:规模较小、可部署的模式需要更好地涵盖它们所服务的语言。

blocks.en: Because the benchmark is a retrieval test posed in English, it is a necessary but not a sufficient condition for producing decodable text. Next steps are versions with items written in the target language, extension of the pipeline to further LMIC languages, and the two upper rungs of the ladder, Decodability Assessment and Decodable Text Generation, which test whether models can apply this knowledge.
blocks.zh: 由于基准是英文提出的检索测试,因此它是产生可解码文本的一个必要但并非充分的条件. 接下来的步骤是带有以目标语言书写的项目的版本,将管道延伸至更多的LMIC语言,以及梯子上的两个上行,可解码性评估和可解码文本生成,它们测试模型是否能够应用这种知识.

blocks.en: Appendix D Hardware Tier Assignment
blocks.zh: 附录D 硬件 分级任务

blocks.en: We grouped the models by the smallest class of device on which they can run locally, so that accuracy can be compared within each deployment class. For each model, we use the total number of parameters as a proxy for the memory needed at inference. We did not run any model on the devices described here, so all the requirements given below are estimates. The tiers describe deployability at an acceptable quality level, not only whether the weights can fit in memory. Two assumptions limit this further. First, we assume that the model is the main task running in the foreground and that other applications are closed; the tiers therefore do not describe normal use with several applications open at the same time. Second, the tier does not correspond to the configuration we benchmarked: all evaluations were run at the best precision available for each model, while the tiers assume a quantised deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们把模型按可以在当地运行的最小设备分类,以便在每个部署类别中比较准确性。 对于每个模型,我们使用总参数数作为推断所需的内存的代用. 我们没有在此处所述的设备上运行任何模型,所以下文给出的所有要求都是估计数. 分级在可接受的质量级别上描述可部署性,而不仅是权重是否适合内存. 两个假设进一步限制了这一点。 首先,我们假设该模型是前台运行的主要任务,其他应用程序关闭;因此,分级不描述正常使用,同时开放多个应用程序. 第二,等级不符合我们基准的配置:所有评价都以最精确的方式进行,可供每个模式使用,而等级则假定进行定量部署。

blocks.en: The assignment uses three gates, applied in order. The first gate is deployment access . We resolve it before any memory calculation, because whether a user can obtain the weights is a different question from whether their hardware can hold them. Closed-weight models are therefore assigned to the cloud tier whatever their size, because they are served only through their vendor’s API. The second gate is data sufficiency : open-weight models whose parameter count is not published are excluded from the comparison rather than assigned to a default tier. The third gate is hardware capacity , described below.
blocks.zh: 任务使用三道门,按顺序实施. 第一个大门是部署通道 我们在任何内存计算之前就解决了,因为用户能否获得权重与其硬件能否持有的问题不同. 因此,无论大小,闭重模型都被分配到云层,因为它们只能通过销售商的API得到服务。 第二个闸门是数据充足性 :参数计数未公布的开量模型被排除在比较之外,而不是被分配到默认的分级. 第三个门是硬件容量,

blocks.en: We estimate the memory required as the total number of parameters, multiplied by the number of bytes per parameter at the precision assumed for that tier, plus 25%. This allowance covers runtime overhead, activations, and a key-value cache for a short or medium context. The key-value cache grows with context length and the number of layers, not with the number of parameters, so the allowance is tight for the smallest models and generous for the largest.
blocks.zh: 我们估计所需的内存是参数总数乘以每参数的字节数,以该级假设的精确度乘以25%。 这一备抵包括运行时间管理费、激活和短期或中期的密钥值缓存。 密钥-值缓存随上下文长度和地层数量而增长,而不是参数数量而增长,因此对最小的模型的允许性很紧,对最大的模型的宽大.

blocks.en: The memory available to the model is only a fraction of the device’s total RAM, and this fraction differs by tier, depending on whether memory is shared with an operating system or dedicated to an accelerator. On mobile and tablet hardware we allow the model 50% of the total, which is a maximum for a well-behaved application rather than a typical value. At workstation level the model is placed in the GPU’s dedicated memory, so we allow 85%.
blocks.zh: 模型可用的内存只是设备总RAM的一小部分,而这一分数因层次而异,取决于内存是和操作系统共享还是专用于加速器. 在移动和平板硬件上,我们允许模型占总量的50%,这个模型对于一个行为良好的应用来说是最大的,而不是典型的值. 在工作站一级,该模型被放置在GPU的专用内存中,所以我们允许85%。

blocks.en: Precision is defined per tier. On mobile and tablet we assume 4 bits, because memory is limited on these devices and 4-bit quantisation is the usual way of deploying a model on them. On a workstation, memory is no longer the limiting factor and precision becomes a real choice, so we assume 8 bits and treat this as a minimum quality level. In the cloud, memory is less of a constraint, so precision never changes the tier a model is assigned to.
blocks.zh: 每层精确度被定义. 在移动和平板上,我们假设4位,因为内存在这些设备上是有限的,而4位的量化是通常在它们上部署模型的方法. 在工作站上,内存不再是限制因素,精度成为了真正的选择,所以我们假设了8个比特,把这当作最低质量水平. 在"云"中,内存的制约性较低,因此精度永远不会改变一个模型被分配到的层次.

blocks.en: Storage is not used in the assignment. With each tier’s quantisation, the model’s size on disk stays well below the free space available on that class of device: 1.6 GB at the top of the mobile tier, 4.8 GB at the top of the tablet tier, and 21.8 GB at the top of the workstation tier.
blocks.zh: 任务中不使用存储。 随着每层的量化,该模型在磁盘上的尺寸远远低于该类设备可用的自由空间:移动级上方为1.6GB,平板级上方为4.8GB,工作站级上方为21.8GB.

blocks.en: We define four tiers, set out in Table A10 . The RAM values are device totals as they appear on a specification sheet: 4 GB corresponds to an entry-level Android phone, 12 GB to a premium phone or a tablet, and 32 GB to the memory of a high-end consumer graphics card. The usable share is the part of this total the model can use once the operating system and other processes have taken what they need, and the model budget is the product of the two. The maximum number of parameters is the largest model this budget can hold at the tier’s precision, after applying the 25% allowance. Since memory is the only real constraint, the assignment reduces to a threshold on parameter count. In Figure 6 , the mobile and tablet tiers are presented together.
blocks.zh: 我们界定了表A10所列的四级。 RAM值是在规格表中出现的设备总和:4GB对应入门级Android手机,12GB对应溢价手机或平板电脑,32GB对应高端消费图形卡的内存. 可用份额是模型一旦操作系统和其他过程取出它们需要的,而模型预算是两者的产物,就可以使用这个总数的一部分. 最高参数数是本预算在适用25%的备抵后,能精确掌握的最大模型。 由于内存是唯一的真正制约,任务会减少到参数计数的阈值. 在图6中,移动层和平板层合并列出。

blocks.en: Sparse (mixture-of-experts) models receive no reduction for the smaller number of parameters they activate per token. The router can choose any expert for any token, so the complete model has to stay in memory, and the total parameter count therefore determines memory exactly as for a dense model. We initially assumed the opposite, and gpt-oss-120b showed that this assumption was wrong in practice. This model has 117 billion parameters in total and activates 5.1 billion per token, so it would belong to the tablet tier if only the second value were considered. Its published requirement, however, is within 80 GB of memory, and local deployments reported by users need about 64 GB. Our estimate at 4 bits with the 25% allowance gives 73 GB, close to the published value. This agreement is partly a coincidence: the allowance is least appropriate for a model of this size, and the model’s native format is slightly above 4 bits, so the two errors partly compensate each other.
blocks.zh: Sparse(专家混合)模型不会因为每个符号激活的参数数量较少而减少。 路由器可以选择任何专家来获取任何符号,因此完整的模型必须留在内存中,因此总参数计数精确地决定了内存与密集模型. 我们最初假设相反,gpt-oss-120b显示,这种假设在实践中是错误的. 这个模型总共有1,710亿个参数,每个符符激活51亿个参数,所以如果只考虑第二个值,它就属于平板阶. 然而,其公布的要求在80GB内存范围内,用户报告的本地部署需要约64GB. 我们4比特的估算值是25%, 给出73GB,接近公布值。 这个协议部分是巧合:这个允许度对于这个大小的模型来说最不合适,模型的本土格式略高于4位,因此这两个错误部分地互相补偿.

blocks.en: Finally, the cloud tier contains two different kinds of model: those whose weights cannot be obtained, and those too large for consumer hardware. Membership of the cloud tier should therefore not be interpreted as meaning that a model is large.
blocks.zh: 最后,云层包含两种不同的模型:重量不能得到的模型和消费硬件太大的模型. 因此,云层的成员不应被解释为意味着一个模型很大。
